form.value: P3-<20 Crockford-alphabet symbols>-<2 check symbols>; profile P3/1
form.derivation: 100 random bits from randomBytes(13) shifted right 4; no site/building/level/space inputs.
form.check: h=(33*h+alphabetIndex+1) mod 1021 over P3 plus payload; high/low base-32 check, not ISO 7064.
form.normalization: ASCII end-space trim and ASCII uppercase; canonical grouping or unseparated form only.

buildingPart.answer: No building part or building-level prefix exists in a space's P3 code. P3 is only a namespace prefix.
buildingPart.location: Structure number is supplied in the reviewed location, not derived from building ordinal or record ID.
buildingPart.locationForm: <anchor> / <structure> / <level(s)> / <space>; mutable display, rejected as resolver identity.
buildingPart.structure: S/U/A plus 01-99, or unknown ? with no number; kind R/C/P/X/U/V plus 001-999 for space.

everySpaceCheckInIdentityPath.check: Requires spaceKind and levels; known spaceKind needs spaceNumber. Not a record-kind check.
Any prior reserved code conflicts, but the message calls the target This space.
Predecessors assigned; boundary successor assigned; messages call them continuing spaces.
Missing captured code is a 409 whose message says This space had no project code.
No kind restriction: recorded record in unarchived area, readable site/manifest, consistent review.
Snapshot project-p3-1 assertion and canonical source-code query currently select spaces only.

buildingWouldHaveToHold.point: Recorded building revision >=1 in authorized site; current exact selected snapshot member.
Own body.evidence source and locator match; evidence source revision in exact snapshot.
Exact unused review: same reviewer, operation, versions, scope, manifest and command hash.
No code already reserved; same transaction, locks, idempotent receipt and post-write snapshot.
A building without sourceOnly cannot omit location: assignmentLocation returns unsupported lineage.
No inherent spaceKind/spaceNumber/level location. Unknown tokens pass syntax, not building policy.
Document-import building has body.evidence, but not the child space's sourceOnly literal envelope.
Removing kind space alone would not define reviewed building identity or a building location profile.

lineage.split: One predecessor, >=2 distinct successors; all current recorded spaces; successors never reserved.
lineage.merge: >=2 predecessors, one successor; all recorded spaces; new code, no old code transferred.
lineage.writes: Retire predecessors, allocate successors, add links/evidence, bump revisions, receipt/outbox atomically.
lineage.correction: Update location/revision, keep code. Cancel/retire keep permanently reserved code.
lineage.boundary: Two continuing assigned spaces keep codes; valid reviewed transferred area plus evidence link.
lineage.qualification: Design demands acyclicity; inspected mutation code has shape/non-reuse checks, no explicit DFS.

answers.answer: Use the existing building identifier; assign P3 only to reviewed independent spaces.
answers.cost: Projection wording plus building card path; no P3 allocator or space lifecycle change.
exactBuildingCardWords: Application identity: Identity codes are for recorded spaces only
